title: Little Nightmares III
description:
Little Nightmares III follows Low and Alone, two children trapped in the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing locations within the Nowhere. Their goal is to survive its residents, solve environmental puzzles and find a path out.

The game can be played solo with an AI companion or with a friend through online co-op on the same platform. Low uses a bow and Alone uses a wrench, giving the pair different ways to interact with threats, mechanisms and environmental obstacles. Friend’s Pass allows one owner to invite another player on the same platform into online co-op.

description_short: Low and Alone travel through the Spiral in an atmospheric horror puzzle-platformer playable solo with an AI companion or in two-player online co-op.
description_ar: مغامرة رعب وألغاز تتابع Low وAlone أثناء محاولتهما الهروب من عالم Spiral، ويمكن لعبها فرديًا مع رفيق يتحكم به الذكاء الاصطناعي أو بتعاون أونلاين بين لاعبين على المنصة نفسها.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
nintendoNotes: Nintendo lists separate Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 versions, with Simplified Chinese support. The Switch 2 version is approximately 9.6 GB. Cooperative play is online for two players; solo play uses an AI companion. Supplier four-tier listings are mapped to Standard/DLC variants per the store rule. No Full Wrap was verified, so 3D texture fields remain blank.
tagline: Escape the Spiral as Low and Alone, combining their bow and wrench to survive grotesque threats, environmental puzzles and online cooperative challenges.
fitFor: Players who enjoy atmospheric horror, environmental storytelling and puzzle-platforming.
Players who want a Little Nightmares adventure designed around two complementary characters.
Friends who want online cooperative play on the same platform.
notFitFor: Players specifically seeking couch co-op; cooperative multiplayer is online rather than local split-screen.
Players who dislike stealth, chase sequences or deliberately unsettling horror imagery.
Players looking for a long open-world campaign; the game is a focused, linear horror adventure.

gameplayPillars.title: Two Complementary Survivors
gameplayPillars.description: Low carries a bow for ranged interactions while Alone uses a wrench for mechanisms and close-range environmental actions.

gameplayPillars.title: Puzzles, Stealth and Chases
gameplayPillars.description: Progress relies on reading the environment, avoiding or outsmarting larger threats and coordinating actions when playing cooperatively.

gameplayPillars.title: Atmospheric Horror
gameplayPillars.description: Scale, sound, lighting and grotesque residents create tension without turning the game into a traditional combat-heavy horror title.

worldSummary: The Spiral is a cluster of eerie locations within the Nowhere, connected by the journey of Low and Alone. Each area combines oversized architecture, hostile inhabitants and environmental storytelling that makes the children feel physically vulnerable. The setting continues the Little Nightmares tradition of communicating much of its history through spaces, props and creatures rather than direct exposition.

storyChapters.title: Low and Alone in the Spiral
storyChapters.body: The two children are trapped in the Spiral and search for a way out while confronting the disturbing places and residents within it.

storyChapters.title: Surviving Together
storyChapters.body: Their distinct tools become essential to traversal and puzzles as the route becomes more dangerous, whether Alone is controlled by AI or another player.

storyChapters.title: Toward an Escape
storyChapters.body: Later sections deepen the series’ themes of vulnerability and the Nowhere while pushing the pair through more demanding encounters; endgame spoilers are omitted.

features: Play as Low and Alone, two children trying to escape the Spiral within the wider Nowhere setting.
Low’s bow and Alone’s wrench provide complementary tools for environmental interaction, puzzles and survival.
The full campaign can be played solo with an AI companion or in online co-op with another player.
Stealth, platforming, environmental puzzles and chase sequences remain central to the Little Nightmares formula.
A Friend’s Pass allows supported co-op access without requiring the second player to own the full game.
The Backstage, released in June 2026, is an additional story chapter included in the Secrets of the Spiral Season Pass.

faq.q: Does Little Nightmares III support co-op?
faq.a: Yes. It supports two-player online co-op on the same platform, while solo players are accompanied by an AI-controlled partner.
No. The cooperative mode is online; there is no local split-screen campaign.

faq.q: Does the game have paid additional content?
faq.a: Yes. Official additional content includes the Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass and additional story chapters/costume content.

verdictSummary:
Score note: 6.9/10 is a direct normalization of the current 69/100 Metacritic aggregate for the Nintendo listing; it is not a separately invented store rating.

Little Nightmares III keeps the series’ disturbing environmental style while making two-character cooperation central to puzzles and traversal. Its strongest new idea is online co-op, while the lack of couch co-op and modest Switch 2 launch performance are important limitations.
verdictPros: Strong atmosphere and environmental art direction.
Complementary character tools create useful cooperative interactions.
Online co-op adds a genuinely new way to experience the series.
verdictCons: No couch co-op despite the two-character design.
Switch 2 launch performance targets 30 FPS and can show dips/stutter.
Focused campaign length may feel short to players seeking a large adventure.
